day_shape: 57 items: CENTCOM says US blockade has redirected 81 vessels and disabled 4, Netanyahu convenes cabinet on reported Israel-US Iran strike prep, Hezbollah rockets/drones wound four IDF troops in south Lebanon, heavy Khamenei-channel messaging, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: US blockade and Iran strike preparations
threads.summary: CENTCOM said the Tripoli Amphibious Ready Group is enforcing a US blockade against Iran, with 81 commercial vessels redirected and 4 disabled as of May 17. Times of Israel reported Netanyahu convened the security cabinet amid reports of Israel-US strike preparations, while the Jerusalem Post reported the Trump administration is urging the UAE to seize Iran's Lavan Island.

threads.label: South Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah fire
threads.summary: The IDF said four troops were wounded, one severely, by a roadside bomb in southern Lebanon overnight, and that Hezbollah fired rockets and explosive drones at forces through the morning, with interceptions reported. IDF Arabic spokesperson Avichay Adraee issued evacuation alerts for villages in West Bekaa, Nabatieh and Sidon districts citing Hezbollah ceasefire violations.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Hamas leadership
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas operations-division commander Bahaa Baroud in an airstrike and struck two further Palestinian operatives in Gaza. The Jerusalem Post reported Hamas failed to elect a new political leader and is seeking to exploit the Hajj for fundraising, while Defa Press carried a Hamas call for mediators to halt strikes on Deir al-Balah.

threads.label: Iran diplomatic outreach to neighbours
threads.summary: Iranian state outlets reported FM Araghchi held phone calls with Qatari PM/FM Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani and South Korean FM Choi Hyun on regional developments. Pakistan's Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi spent roughly three hours meeting President Pezeshkian and separately met Speaker Qalibaf, who said US regional presence creates insecurity.

threads.label: Tehran messaging on war and adversaries
threads.summary: Khamenei's office invoked Ferdowsi's Shahnameh framing Iran's "third sacred defence," while a Defence Ministry spokesman called Trump and Netanyahu "the most hated figures in the world" and an unnamed military official denied Iranian responsibility for operations against regional countries. IRIB-aligned channels also claimed a widespread fire at an Israeli base in the Negev and amplified Western press items on coal use and US farmer bankruptcies.

events.title_en: Pursuing violations against Iran's cultural heritage within the framework of international responsibility
events.summary_en: Pursuing violations against Iran's cultural heritage within the framework of international responsibility. The Legal and International Deputy of the Foreign Minister stated: Damage to Iran's cultural heritage during the recent aggression shows that the scope of violations has gone beyond the prohibition of force and protection of civilians and has also targeted the historical and civilisational memory of the Iranian people. At least 149 historical artefacts and museums in 20 provinces of the country have been damaged in the recent imposed war, among which five UNESCO World Heritage sites, seven historic districts and 54 museums stand out. Under the 1954 Hague Convention and the fundamental rules of international humanitarian law, cultural property in armed conflicts must be respected and protected.
